svg.title: 12 — Lifted Praise — Tabernacle of Praise — DRAFT
svg.desc: DRAFT — NOT FOR PUBLICATION. A steady dwelling-name is answered by a gently rising word of praise. Bricolage Grotesque outlines at weight 550 / width 100 / optical size 24; the Tabernacle line remains stable. The six Praise letters rise 4.5 canvas units per letter without rotating or distorting their shapes; of remains readable. Risk: Baseline movement can feel playful or like event typography rather than an enduring church identifier; the name is expressive but not inherently a compact symbol.
